extName.message: Dark Mode — fast dark theme for any website

extDescription.message: Dark theme for any website with no white flash and no lag. Two engines, brightness, schedule, per-site list. Free.

cmdToggleSite.message: Turn on or off for the current site

statusForcedFilter.message: The page is very large, so the fast engine is used.

statusAlreadyDark.message: This site is already dark, so it is left as is.

statusScheduleSystem.message: Off right now: the system theme is light.

statusScheduleTime.message: Off right now by schedule (dark from $1 to $2).

statusError.message: Could not apply the theme on this page.

restricted.message: The browser does not let extensions change this page (browser pages, the extension store). If it is a regular site opened before installation, reload it.

optionsLead.message: A fast dark theme for any website. Free, no account, everything stays in your browser.

globalHint.message: The main switch. Sites in the list below have their own settings.

engineDynamicHint.message: Recolors the site’s own styles. Images and video stay untouched. Best for most sites.

engineFilterHint.message: Inverts the page with a single CSS filter and turns images back to their original colors. Almost zero load, great for heavy pages.

detectDark.message: Leave sites that are already dark alone

scheduleSystem.message: Follow the system (when Windows, macOS or Linux uses a dark theme)

sitesHint.message: A rule for example.com also covers its subdomains. It is easiest to switch sites from the extension popup.

sitesAddInvalid.message: Enter a site address, e.g. example.com

sitesEmpty.message: No rules yet: the dark theme works the same on every site.

importFailed.message: This file does not fit: a JSON site list is expected.

aboutPrivacy.message: The extension makes no network requests, collects no statistics and shows no ads. Settings are stored only in this browser.
